comparison.objective: Assemble shock-corded mast sections into a straight, fully seated pole and lay it across two stands.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated coaxial section alignment/insertion under cord tension, not hammer-driven tang fracture and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Every joint is fully seated, mast is straight, rests across both stands, and is released; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Shared coaxial alignment is only a generic primitive; the mast tests repeated intact insertion and support placement, while the candidate tests selective fracture and recovery.
